Supporting Experiential Learning Opportunities for Students with Disabilities
=============================================================================

Introduction
------------

Limited research explores the experiences of disability resource professionals who support students with disabilities in accessing experiential learning outside the classroom environment. This study used an explanatory sequential mixed methods approach to investigate whether and how accommodations are provided to and used by students with disabilities (SWDs) during experiential learning outside the classroom.

Findings
--------

The study found that many higher education institutions focus on the classroom needs of SWDs to the exclusion of other, equally critical academic needs. Themes identified in both a national survey and qualitative interviews highlight the need to provide additional support for SWDs outside the classroom.

Conclusion
----------

The study suggests that higher education institutions should provide more comprehensive support for SWDs, including accommodations and services that address their unique needs outside the classroom. By doing so, institutions can ensure that SWDs have equal access to experiential learning opportunities and can fully participate in all aspects of their education.

About the Authors
-------------------

* Aquino, Katherine C.
* Plump, Carolyn

Publication Information
----------------------

* Journal of College Student Development
* Volume 63, Issue 3
* May-June 2022
* Johns Hopkins University Press
* DOI: 10.1353/csd.2022.0022

Note
----

This article was published in the Journal of College Student Development, volume 63, issue 3, May-June 2022. The article is available online at <https://doi.org/10.1353/csd.2022.0022>.

```yaml
title: AXI4Lite e-lite ECMA
tags:
  - axios
  - VHDL
  - SystemVerilog
  - TSX

description: |
  AXI4Lite e-lite ECMA is a lightweight, open-source implementation of the AXI4Lite protocol, designed for use in FPGA-based systems. This project includes a range of tools and resources for working with AXI4Lite, including a configurable IP core, simulation models, and documentation.

features:
  - Configurable AXI4Lite IP core
  - Simulation models for AXI4Lite transactions
  - Documentation and tutorials for using AXI4Lite in FPGA designs
  - Support for Synopsys VCS and Cadence Genus synthesis tools

dependencies:
  - axios ^0.21.1
  - VHDL ^0.0.1
  - SystemVerilog ^0.0.1
  - TSX ^0.0.1

devDependencies:
  - @types/axios ^0.21.1
  - @types/vhdl ^0.0.1
  - @types/systemverilog ^0.0.1
  - @types/tsx ^0.0.1

 peerDependencies:
  - fpga-utils ^0.0.1

scripts:
  - build: yarn run build
  - clean: yarn run clean
  - test: yarn run test
  - simulate: yarn run simulate
  - synth: yarn run synth

build:
  src: ['src/**/*.{vhd,sv}']
  dest: 'dist/axi4lite.tar.gz'
  env:
    PATH: ${PATH}:./bin
  shell: |
    rm -rf dist && \
      vcs --version || exit 1 && \
      genus --version || exit 1 && \
      vivado --version || exit 1 && \
      (cd src && git archive HEAD > /dev/null) && \
      tar -czf dist/axi4lite.tar.gz src && \
      rm -rf src

clean:
  files: ['dist']

test:
  src: ['tests/**/*.test.js']
  env:
    NODE_ENV: test
  shell: |
    node tests

simulate:
  src: ['src/**/*.vhd']
  env:
    VIRTUOSO_HOME: /path/to/virtuoso
  shell: |
    virtuoso_vivado -C -m top -t ps -q

synth:
  src: ['src/**/*.vhd']
  env:
    XILINX_ Vivado_Home: /path/to/vivado
  shell: |
    vivado synth -part xc7z010clg400-1 -top top -lef xilinx.lef -def _default.v HDL Design.v
```
